data.name: Slime Saga
data.detailed_description:
Slime Saga is a free-to-play third-person story-driven monster taming game, but instead of taming your monsters, you create them! Using slime, you as the next best up-and-coming tamer must make your monster, and put them to battle against the slime monsters of the wilderness. Travel through the many winding paths of the Rolling Hills, the Wild Canyon, the Mystic Caves and beyond with your friend Jasper as you meet other slime tamers to aid and befriend along the way. Discover more than 60 slime monsters of all shapes and sizes as you explore the wilderness, with more upcoming monsters and levels on the way in future updates!

Train slimes, make friends, and get set for adventure!

You can play solo through the main story or enjoy playing with friends in online co-op! It's time to pick up your slime catcher and become the latest and greatest tamer!

Create your Own Slime Tamer

Create and customize your very own tamer with a variety of clothing and hairstyles to choose from! Earn coins through exploration and battles to purchase new looks for your character.

Collect a Wide Variety of Slimes for Battle

There are dozens of unique slime monsters to meet in the world of Slime Saga. Battling with wild slimes gives you a chance to earn their shapestones, which can be used to create your very own monsters. Mix and match slime cores to create the ultimate slimes for battle in a complex element-based system.

High Octane Real Time Combat

Take control of your slimes in battle where you can lock in to enemies, guard and interrupt attacks. Use a plethora of skills that your slime can learn through the lab to get the upper hand in battle, as well as making use of inventory items and special attacks in a clutch.

Story-based Branching Dialogue and Relationship System

Enjoy a story told through multiple cutscenes that introduce many colorful characters throughout the world of Slime Saga! Cutscenes offer players branching dialogue choices that affect relationships with these characters.

Online Multiplayer Mode

Slime Saga can be played alone or online with other players in the online mode. Interact with other players in the city hub using the chat features, or go explore the various field areas and battle with friends. In the stadium, players can engage in battles with other players!

Furnish your Own Place (Coming soon!)

Customize your own space with furnishings of your choice! Find a style that fits you and make the pad of your dreams with all kinds of furniture and color options.
